knowledge.progressSummary: PROGRESS: Proved entropy_chain_rule (H(X,Y)=H(Y)+H(X|Y)) and subadditivity (H(X,Y)≤H(X)+H(Y)). 1 sorry remains: strong_subadditivity. Built KL bound infrastructure and marginal positivity helpers for SSA.
builtItems: def marginalXY, marginalYZ, marginalY_3: three-variable marginal distributions
theorem entropy_chain_rule (PROVED): H(X,Y) = H(Y) + H(X|Y) — per-term log splitting + telescoping
theorem subadditivity (PROVED): H(X,Y) ≤ H(X) + H(Y) — chain rule + conditioning_reduces_entropy bridge
theorem strong_subadditivity (sorry): H(X,Y,Z)+H(Y) ≤ H(X,Y)+H(Y,Z) — KL bound + marginal positivity infrastructure ready
have kl_bound: pointwise KL bound for SSA proof
have mxy_pos/myz_pos/my_pos: marginal positivity from joint positivity
insights: SSA is equivalent to I(X;Z|Y) ≥ 0 (conditional MI non-negativity)
SSA proof strategy: express SSA as conditional KL divergence via Σ_y p(y) D(p(x,z|y) || p(x|y)p(z|y)) ≥ 0
Subadditivity follows from entropy chain rule + conditioning reduces entropy: H(X,Y) = H(Y) + H(X|Y) ≤ H(Y) + H(X)
entropy_chain_rule proven via per-term log splitting log(p) = log(p/py) + log(py) and telescoping
Bridge lemma approach: condEntropy ≡ conditionalEntropy, shannonEntropy ≡ shannonEntropy via simp unfold
SSA remaining sorry needs: telescoping marginal entropy sums to triple sums, then pointwise KL bound application
nextSteps: Prove strong_subadditivity: need telescoping helper to convert Σ_{xy} mxy*log(mxy) = Σ_{xyz} p*log(mxy)
Then combine four entropy terms into single triple sum, apply kl_bound pointwise
Show reference measure sum = 1: Σ_{xyz} pXY*pYZ/pY = Σ_y pY = 1
